description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing employee salary components in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and handling salary components and direct deposit details specific to an employee, distinguished by URL parameters such as employee number and component ID.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee salary components, including CRUD operations, validation, and handling salary and direct deposit details for specified employees.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee salary component by employee number and component ID, returning a resource representation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all salary components for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new salary component entry for an employee, including optional direct deposit information.

methods.name: setEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeSalary entity with data from request parameters, including validation against pay grade limits.

methods.name: setEmployeeDirectDebitToEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Sets or removes direct deposit details to/from an EmployeeSalary entity based on the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee salary component, including salary and direct deposit details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for listing salary components.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a salary component.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Shared validation rules used for create and update requests, including conditional rules based on direct deposit flag.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a salary component, extending create rules with entity ID validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified salary components for an employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting salary components, validating employee number and IDs.
